title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta5

## Canonical authority cutover

This beta performs the planned 0.5 architecture cutover. Canonical Mower State
is no longer a shadow candidate: it becomes the public resolved-state owner,
with ZoneLedger / CycleEngine owning current per-zone progress, task totals and
vendor current-cycle identity.

The matching frontend prerelease is **Navimower Map Card 0.4.0-beta5**.

## Public state ownership

- Position is projected from the canonical PositionResolver: fresh official MQTT
  wins; sparse/stale MQTT falls back to private-cloud position.
- ZoneLedger publishes current `zone_states`, map totals and task totals.
- Public Task progress / Task mowed area / Map coverage / Map mowed area sensors
  read the canonical CycleEngine totals.
- Current vendor-state semantics from beta3 remain in force: fresh vendor
  coverage may decrease to 0%; History does not repaint the current map.
- VendorTrailStore remains the current-cycle geometry owner; History remains the
  archive owner.
- Gate, Schedule, weather, georeference and service-command domains keep their
  existing dedicated owners; the cutover does not move those mature domains
  into frontend logic.

## Paired resource contract v2

The Map API now advertises a paired resource contract:

- `contract.version = 2`
- authority: `canonical_mower_state`
- cycle owner: `ZoneLedger`
- history owner: `History`
- current-cycle resources: MapArtifactManager / VendorTrailStore
- prepared live/history resources remain backend-owned

A compact `canonical` block exposes device/navigation/task/cycle ownership and
provenance. Exact position coordinates are not duplicated into that block.

Top-level Map API aliases remain for this cutover beta so the change can be
field-tested without combining authority migration and compatibility deletion in
one release. Those aliases are generated from the new backend authority.

## Wrapper direction

This beta replaces the temporary Canonical shadow hook with an authoritative
projection and promotes ZoneLedger out of shadow mode. It does not add a new
feature wrapper for zone/task ownership. The following cleanup beta will remove
superseded legacy wrappers/aliases after field validation.

## Retained fixes

- beta3 vendor-current-state reset behavior remains unchanged;
- Mowed remains cutting-only;
- beta4 forward-only >5 m vendor trail gap guard remains active;
- existing retained routes are still not retroactively rewritten.

Test this as the matching pair:

- Navimower 0.5.0-beta5
- Navimower Map Card 0.4.0-beta5
